  -DFUZZING_BUILD_MODE_UNSAFE_FOR_PRODUCTION \
  -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 \
  -I/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/lwan/src/lib \
  /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c \

message.content: The issue is that `lwan.h` includes `<pthread.h>` which gets redirected to the missing version. Let me try a different approach - compile without the missing headers directory:
